title: Platinum clusters Ptn+/0/– (n = 3–21): from triangles to remarkable tubular architectures
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19273-19286
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02668G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bao-Ngan Nguyen-Ha, My-Phuong Pham-Ho, Nguyen Minh Tam, Minh Tho Nguyen
This paper reports on a theoretical investigation of Ptn+/0/– clusters with n = 3–21 in three-charge states using density functional theory with the B3PW91 functional in conjunction with the aug-cc-pVTZ-PP and Def2-TZVP basis sets.
